text: [152] 62 chahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ . katamehi chahi idha bhikkhave bhikkhu khippanisanti ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu sutānañca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko 1 hoti dhatānañca dhammānaṃ atthupaparikkhī hoti atthamaññāya dhammamaññāya dhammānudhammapaṭipanno ca hoti kalyāṇavāco ca hoti kalyāṇavākkaraṇo poriyā vācāya samannāgato vissaṭṭhāya anelagaḷāya atthassa viññāpaniyā sandassako ca hoti samādapako samuttejako sampahaṃsako sabrahmacārīnaṃ . imehi kho bhikkhave chahi dhammehi samannāgato bhikkhu alaṃ attano alaṃ paresaṃ .
